_comment: Tier-2 for dune::hyperelasticity#0, #1 and #4, on an 8x8 dimRange=2 Neo-Hookean problem; wall time 56 s warm on 2026-08-06 (dune-fem 2.12.0.2). #0 and #1 are checked by INTEGRATING the energy density at the reference configuration, which needs no solve: the correct W = mu/2 (tr C - d) - mu ln J + lam/2 (ln J)^2 integrates to 0 at F = I, while dropping the -d leaves exactly mu/2*d; and det(grad(u)) at the reference is 0.000000e+00, so ln(J) is -inf — F = grad(u) really is singular there. #4 IS FALSIFIED AS WRITTEN and the fixture asserts the correction. The claim says to specify just the energy W and let scheme.solve() build the derivatives. Measured, dune-fem accepts neither energy route: derivative(Pi, uh, v) is a ONE-form and galerkin rejects it with ValueError 'Integrands model requires form with at least two arguments.', and taking P = dW/dF with ufl.variable + ufl.diff dies in dune's own code generator with TypeError 'RestrictionPropagator.variable() takes 3 positional arguments but 4 were given'. The first variation has to be written out (here P = mu(F - F^-T) + lam ln(J) F^-T); what IS automatic is the TANGENT, and the fixture shows that by solving with 3 Newton iterations and no hand-coded Jacobian. hyperelasticity#2 (load stepping) is NOT covered: at the load reachable here the one-shot solve converged in the same 3 Newton iterations as each of ten substeps, so the configuration does not distinguish them and claiming it would be false coverage. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 puts the CORRECT Neo-Hookean energy in the slot where the base run drops the -d term. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'dropping_minus_d_leaves_residual_energy=True', 'dune_hyperelasticity_energy_traps_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
expect_in_output: Integrands model requires form with at least two arguments.
